description:
Role Description
  
Overall Solution Ownership
  
Own Solution Development as the liaison between Sales and Delivery teams — serving as technical bridge between the sales team, clients, and delivery support up to and including contract negotiations.
  
Can lead solutioning of pursuits \>$40M TCV
  
Experience in Business Case Development, Deal Shaping, Negotiation, Offering Insight, Value Analysis, and Prioritisation.
  
Develop winnable and profitable solution proposals that meet client requirements while maintaining commercial integrity.
  
Excellent client relationship management at mid\-to\-senior executive level, with strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  
Automation \& Agentic AI
  
Architect end\-to\-end automation solutions on workflow orchestration covering ticket triage, intelligent routing, auto\-resolution, and closure using ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  
Design and position agentic AI capabilities — LLM\-powered virtual agents, autonomous remediation bots, and AI — integrated into service desk workflows.
  
Build self\-service and contact\-deflection strategies targeting measurable reductions in contact volume and mean\-time\-to\-resolve (MTTR).
  
Establish guardrails, audit trails, and feedback loops to ensure agentic solutions are safe, explainable, and continuously improving.
  
Ways of Working \& Operating Model
  
Champion shift\-left, knowledge\-centered service (KCS), and DevOps practices within service desk solution designs.
  
Define tiering, routing, and escalation models that balance cost\-to\-serve with user experience outcomes.
  
Establish SLA/XLA frameworks and a metrics hierarchy that connects team activities to measurable business outcomes.
  
Platform \& Tooling
  
Deep understanding of ITSM and ITAM tooling, and the integrations between the service desk platform and adjacent systems: CMDB, identity, endpoint management, observability, and enterprise applications.
  
Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
  
Serve as trusted advisor to client CxOs on service desk strategy, technology investment, and transformation direction.
  
Translate complex architecture concepts into compelling business narratives for senior executives and non\-technical sponsors.
  
Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level architects within the service desk practice
  
Qualifications \& Experience
  
Experience
  
15\+ years in IT service management \& service desk roles, in a solution or enterprise architecture capacity.
  
Proven track record designing and delivering large\-scale ITSM platform transformations in complex, multi\-geography organisations.
  
Demonstrable hands\-on experience architecting automation and AI solutions in live service desk environments
  
Exposure to managed service provider (MSP) models, outsourcing deal structures, and sourcing strategy is required.
  
Track record of senior client\-facing leadership — credibly engaging and influencing CxO, Board, and Procurement stakeholders in competitive pursuit scenarios.
  
Technical Depth
  
**ITSM platforms:** like ServiceNow (preferred), Jira Service Management
  
**Automation \& workflow:** like UiPath, Ansible, ServiceNow Flow Designer, Power Automate.
  
**Agentic \& AI:** LLM orchestration, RAG architecture
  
**Observability \& AIOps:** like Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk — event correlation and intelligent alerting.
  
**Contact Centre:** like AWS Connect, Genesys — architecture and integration into ITSM workflows.
  
**Language \& communication tooling:** like Krisp\+ and equivalent real\-time translation/transcription platforms
  
Frameworks \& Certifications
  
ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
  
**Architecture certifications:** AWS / Microsoft / GCP Solutions Architect advantageous.
  
Behaviours \& Soft Skills
  
Strategic thinker who can zoom in to debug a workflow and zoom out to present a 3\-year vision.
  
Location
  
Flexible / Any hub location. Willingness to travel for client meetings and operate across global time zones expected.
  
  

Overview
  
The Service Desk Solution Architect is a senior client facing role responsible for shaping and owning end to end ITSM and service desk solutions across large, commercially complex outsourcing and transformation engagements. Should be capable to lead 40M pursuits acting as the primary technical authority who translates client business problems into differentiated, AI powered service desk solutions.
  
The individual brings deep expertise across the ITSM platform landscape, automation tooling, agentic AI, and modern service desk ways of working. Can define solution strategy, shaping operating models, and building compelling business cases that resonate at CxO level.
  
The role demands a high calibre blend of technical and commercial capability owning the solution blueprint and roadmap, driving self service and deflection strategies, and transitioning winning solutions into delivery with full operational credibility. The individual will work across sales pursuit teams, delivery, commercial, and client stakeholders and will be a visible leader both internally and in the market.

title: Associate Technical Architect
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.  

  

If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!

**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a Associate Architect *SD who* has led a team and who uses generative AI heavily to deliver day\-to\-day engineering work.


This is a builder's role with an architect's habits. You will own problems from the vague first description through to something running in production, and you will do it by directing AI rather than by typing every line yourself. You will work closely with the Tech Architect as a thinking partner across product and engineering.

**What You Should Know**
------------------------

### **Working with AI (mandatory)**


This is the part we will not compromise on. You should be able to point to real delivery, not experiments or weekend reading.

* **Spec\-driven development.** You have worked from a written spec that an agent executes against. Frameworks such as GSD, BMAD or SpecKit, or an equivalent approach your team built in\-house.
* **Harness engineering.** Hands\-on with an agent harness such as Claude Code, Kiro or GitHub Copilot. You have configured and shaped one, not only typed into it.
* **Sub\-agents.** You understand how to split work across agents, and where that helps and where it makes things worse.
* **Skills and custom agents.** You have built reusable skills or custom agents for your own workflow rather than using only what came out of the box.
* **Judgment about all of the above.** You know where these methods break down, because you have hit it.


Good to have, and worth telling us about: context and token efficiency, evaluating agent output at scale, cost control, or your own tooling built on top of a harness. This field moves faster than any list we can write, so if you have gone further than the bullets above, say where.

### **Engineering breadth**


We care about range more than depth in any single technology.

* Comfortable across layers: frontend behaviour, backend services and API design, and how data is modelled and stored.
* React, TypeScript, Node, Python, relational and document databases are the kind of ground we work on. You should be able to operate on most of it.
* Able to hold an architecture discussion and design a system, rather than recall framework specifics.

### **Cloud and delivery**

* Hands\-on with a major cloud provider, AWS or GCP.
* Comfortable with Docker.
* Able to set up CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
* Familiar with logging and observability tooling.

**Experience Required**
-----------------------


All three are required. If you do not meet all three, this is not the right role for you right now.

 **At least five years building software professionally.**

**You have led a team.** Formal reports or a tech lead role with no reporting line both count. What matters is that you have actually led, not what the title said.

**You have worked across layers, not inside one.** We are not looking for a specialist in a single part of the stack.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **End\-to\-end delivery**


Take a problem from first description to delivered feature. Turn vague requirements into a technical plan, and surface risks and trade\-offs while they are still cheap to act on.


You drive that delivery with generative AI. Spec\-driven development and agent harnesses are how the work gets done here, not a side experiment.

### **Architecture thinking**


Hold the architecture in your head: how the frontend, the services and the data layer fit together, and where each will strain.


You need that so you can work with an agent to reach the right design, review what it proposes, and catch the choice that will hurt in six months. You are not expected to hand\-build every layer yourself.

### **Technical and product judgment**


You have built real software before, and it shows in the questions you ask. An agent will happily produce code that works on a clean slate, and most of our work is not a clean slate. Reading an existing system, understanding why it is shaped the way it is, and changing it without breaking things is the job.


You should also be able to tell where AI genuinely belongs in a product and where it does not, with a working sense of the cost, latency and failure modes involved.

### **Quality and production readiness**


You set the standard for what ships. When most of the code is agent\-written, the skill is not typing it cleanly. It is knowing what good looks like and catching what is wrong in review.

### **Working with people**


You work closely with the Tech Architect, product managers and other engineers. You raise blockers early and bring options with them.

**When You Apply**
------------------


Be ready to walk us through one feature you shipped where an agent wrote most of the code: what you specified up front, what came back wrong, and what you had to fix yourself.


Link a pull request or repository if the work is public. Most of this work sits behind a company firewall, and that counts against you not at all.

**Why This Role Is Different**
------------------------------


This is not a traditional full\-stack engineering job, and the difference is not cosmetic.


The engineers who do well here think in user journeys, systems and outcomes rather than tickets. They own problems rather than tasks. And they treat AI as the way the work gets done, not as a tool they occasionally reach for.


If that describes how you already work, this will feel like the obvious next role. If it does not, it will be a frustrating one.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled **ASIC Verification Engineer (IP \& SoC)** with 5 to 10 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor verification. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining and executing verification strategies for complex IPs and SoCs, developing scalable UVM\-based verification environments, and validating high\-speed protocols such as AMBA AXI and PCIe. This role requires strong debugging expertise, automation skills, and experience working with industry\-standard EDA verification tools.
Responsibilities:
### **Verification Planning \& Execution**

* Define, develop, and execute comprehensive verification plans at both IP and SoC levels.
* Drive verification closure through functional coverage, code coverage, assertions, and regression analysis.
* Develop verification methodologies aligned with project requirements and quality standards.

### **Testbench Architecture \& Development**

* Architect and develop scalable, reusable constrained\-random verification environments using **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Create verification components, scoreboards, monitors, checkers, and reusable testbench infrastructure.
* Develop and execute directed, random, and stress test scenarios.

### **AMBA AXI Verification**

* Verify and validate **AXI3, AXI4, and AXI5** based subsystems.
* Validate AXI Interconnects, NoCs (Network\-on\-Chip), and multi\-layer bus architectures.
* Analyze and verify out\-of\-order transaction handling, latency optimization, and bandwidth performance.

### **PCIe Sub\-System Verification**

* Verify PCIe Gen3, Gen4, Gen5, and Gen6 controller functionality across Physical, Data Link, and Transaction Layers.
* Validate high\-performance DMA engines operating in Endpoint and Root Complex configurations.
* Ensure protocol compliance and robust performance under various traffic conditions.

### **Protocol \& Performance Verification**

* Verify high\-speed industry\-standard protocols and ensure compliance with protocol specifications.
* Execute performance verification to validate throughput, latency, and system\-level behavior.
* Support low\-power verification methodologies using UPF/CPF where applicable.

### **Debugging \& Failure Analysis**

* Debug complex simulation failures and identify root causes in RTL designs.
* Perform protocol\-level debugging and waveform analysis.
* Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to resolve issues efficiently.

### **Gate\-Level Simulation (GLS)**

* Set up and execute gate\-level simulations with and without timing annotations.
* Analyze timing\-related issues and support pre\-silicon signoff activities.

### **Automation \& Productivity Enhancement**

* Develop automation scripts using Python, Perl, or Tcl.
* Improve regression execution, result analysis, coverage tracking, and verification workflows.

Requirements:
### **Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Communication Engineering, VLSI, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of proven experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
* Strong background in IP\-level and SoC\-level verification projects.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Hands\-on experience with constrained\-random verification methodologies.
* Solid understanding of AMBA AXI protocols (AXI3/4/5\).
* Experience in verifying PCIe Gen3/4/5/6 subsystems.
* Knowledge of Network\-on\-Chip (NoC), interconnect architectures, and DMA engines.
* Experience with protocol compliance, functional coverage, assertions, and verification closure.

### **Low Power \& Performance Verification**

* Experience with low\-power verification using **UPF/CPF** (preferred).
* Understanding of performance verification techniques and system\-level analysis.

### **Automation Skills**

* Proficiency in scripting using **Python, Perl, or Tcl**.
* Experience automating verification and regression environments.

### **EDA Tools**


Hands\-on experience with one or more industry\-standard simulators:

* Synopsys VCS
* Cadence Xcelium
* Siemens Questa/QuestaSim

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with gate\-level simulations and timing analysis.
* Exposure to advanced verification methodologies and reusable verification IPs.
* Strong debugging, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced product development environment.
